Skeleton Recall Loss numerical definition and tubed-GT construction are adapted from MIC-DKFZ/Skeleton-Recall, Apache-2.0, commit c7bac3c72ca7bb4f3d891235f051f0c4d07d7229.

Source: https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/Skeleton-Recall

The project implementation in parse22_supervised/skeleton_recall.py ports the binary, single-GPU loss and post-augmentation target extension to the installed older U-Mamba/batchgenerators API. No upstream environment is replaced. The evaluation skeleton protocol remains undilated and unchanged.
